delightkitr 0.0.0.9000
  • Reference

    Embed the mitosis specimen delighter

    dk_specimen.Rd

    A self-contained, mouse/touch-reactive organic shape with no function – species #1 of delightkitr's interactive surface, ported from the Artifact prototype "A Part That Does Nothing". Click it, drag it, hover over it, watch it split. Nothing is saved; nothing is measured except a tally that means nothing.

    dk_specimen(width = "420px")

    Arguments

    width

    CSS width for the widget's stage, e.g. "420px" or "100%". The stage never exceeds this value but will shrink to fit a narrower container (a sidebar, a Shiny panel column, ...).

    Value

    A htmltools::browsable()-wrapped htmltools::HTML() object – printing it at the console opens it in the RStudio Viewer, printing it in a Quarto/R Markdown chunk renders it inline (no results='asis' needed), and it works directly as Shiny UI.

    Details

    Fully self-contained (fonts inlined, no external requests, no JS dependencies) and safe to embed more than once on the same page – each call generates its own unique element IDs and scopes its CSS to a wrapper class, so instances never collide with each other or with the host page's own styles.

    Examples

    if (interactive()) {
  dk_specimen()
}
